checks: cargo check -p world --features peta with the folder present; cargo check --all-features on the public export without it
cost: O(1): one environment lookup and one stat.
description: Sets cfg(mova_legacy_worlds) only when feature worlds is on and peta/world/legacy/worlds exists; otherwise warns (feature on) or does nothing, so a public checkout compiles with --all-features.
forward: Always: rustc-check-cfg for mova_legacy_worlds and rerun-if-changed=build.rs. Feature worlds on and folder present: rerun-if-changed=<folder> and rustc-cfg=mova_legacy_worlds. Feature on and folder absent: one cargo warning.
inverse: The cfg recovers feature on and folder present; its absence plus a warning recovers feature on and folder absent; no warning and no cfg means feature off. Folder contents are not recoverable.
limitations: Does not check the 33 manual files individually; a partial folder fails at include_str!. No unit test; checked by compiling both ways.
state: Stateless; output depends on CARGO_FEATURE_WORLDS and the folder's existence at script run time.
